comprehensive_ml_oxide_dataset.name: Train XGBoost model
comprehensive_ml_oxide_dataset.description: Generate a comprehensive dataset of oxide polymorphs from Materials Project and train an XGBoost model to predict formation energies. This task includes: (1) retrieving a diverse set of polymorphs with oxide composition, (2) consolidating data into ML-ready format, (3) training XGBoost model, and (4) evaluating model performance with cross-validation. At the end Comprehensively evaluate the trained XGBoost model using test set metrics, cross-validation, and detailed error analysis. Assess model generalization capability, feature importance, and prediction reliability across different oxide compositions and structural families. The file should have two things mandatory `test_set_evaluation` and `cross_validation_results` use the same key name when saving results for this.
